CustomField.description: Link to the call recording, written by the Callsign CTI on every recorded call. Not part of the 360 CTI package, so it works for reps without a tdc_cti license and anyone who can open the task can see it. Do not edit by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Opens the recording of this call. Set automatically by the CTI.
